name: Apostles The
overview: The apostles were divinely commissioned messengers who were empowered to boldly proclaim Christ’s teachings openly and without fear, as emphasized in Matthew 10:27-31. They were assured of God’s intimate knowledge and care, being valued even more than sparrows, and were called to confess Christ before men with the promise of His acknowledgment before the Father (Matthew 10:32). Their ministry involved fearless proclamation of the gospel, grounded in the authority and presence of Christ, who entrusted them with this sacred mission.
